review:
Red Rascal is a devilish funhouse slot on paylines. When three or more Rascal symbols land together they trigger a respin where Colossal Rascals can form, and a pendulum switches between Coin and Wild mode before turning every Rascal into Coins, Colossal Coins, Wilds or Colossal Wilds.

That pendulum decides how each respin pays out, which keeps the base game unpredictable. Hacksaw publishes 4/5 volatility, a 15,000x max win and RTP versions from 96.34% down to 86.35%. It suits players who want a high-volatility game with a clear central mechanic.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.35% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
